description:
Reviews uncommitted vault changes, then stages and commits them to git.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit. Read-only.
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review:
    --max-file-lines N  maximum diff lines shown per file. Default 150.
    --max-lines N       maximum lines of output overall. Default 3000.
  save:
    --message SUBJECT  required. One line, not empty.
    --body TEXT        commit body; may span several lines
    --dry-run          report what would be staged and committed; change nothing

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB meeting and flush buffer", "--body", "Added kickoff note, 3h hours entry, two actions."]

Notes:
  Run review first, write a summary from its output, then run save with that summary.
  save only adds a commit. It never amends, rebases, resets or pushes.
  Exit code 1 means: an empty or multi-line --message, the vault is not the root of a git repository, or a git command failed.
